newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokio Marine to support NCB if other firms do so.
newsitem.headline: Tokio Marine to support NCB if other firms do so.

text.p: Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd would provide financial support to help Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) restructure if other financial institutions were to provide support as well, an executive of the leading non-life insurance company said on Thursday.
The remarks were made at a news conference at which Tokio Marine announced its 1996/97 business results.

Sources at the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd said earlier on Thursday that the bank would buy 17 billion yen worth of new NCB shares as requested by NCB if other financial institutions were to agree to buy new shares as well.
NCB has been asking major banks and life and non-life insurers to buy the bank's new ordinary and preferred shares worth about 300 billion yen.
